rating_anchors.0: Absent or potentially counterproductive, only when supported by observable evidence.
rating_anchors.1: Emerging, partially demonstrated or poorly timed.
rating_anchors.NE: Not enough evidence; must not be converted to zero.

limitations: Experimental educational feedback; not clinically or psychometrically validated.
No aggregate competency score, pass/fail decision, or trainee ranking.
Patient response alone does not establish therapist competency.
